Name: Aijalon in Zebulun
ModernLocation: Disputed; Tel el Butmeh area, in Zebulun's allotment
Description: A town in Zebulun's allotment where the judge Elon was buried, named only in the burial notice of Judges 12:12.
BiblicalSignificance: Its single mention marks the burial place of Elon, one of the minor judges, in the northern tribal allotment, distinct from the Aijalon of the Aijalon Valley in the south.
